_comment: Merge these into the 'scripts' object of your package.json. 'visual' targets a Linux sandbox using @sparticuz/chromium (npm-shipped Chromium — no CDN download). 'visual:local' targets a dev machine (Windows/macOS) and auto-detects an installed Chrome/Edge, or honors the ABOT_CHROME env var. Both run node tools/visual-check.js (adjust the path if you place the script elsewhere).
devDependencies_note: On a dev machine you only need: npm install --save-dev puppeteer-core. In a Linux sandbox ALSO run: npm install --no-save @sparticuz/chromium (its system libs/fonts are extracted manually — see SANDBOX-BROWSER-VISUAL-TESTS.md steps 2–3).
